marks.q: By virtue of our significant investment in human resources, restructuring and market-leading products and promotions, we expect full year revenue and profits to be at least at the upper end of market expectations.

The Company therefore expects to report revenue of around USD 410m and adjusted EBITDA of around USD 45m for the financial year ended 31 December 2021, c.5% ahead of consensus of USD 383m and USD 42.9m respectively.

Given the early stage of the current financial year the Directors have yet to fully ascertain the expected impact on full year performance, which should however be at least at or above the high end of market expectations*.
